caption: The drawing depicts the interior of a luxurious train carriage, furnished with a long, tufted red-brown sofa against the back wall, with a brown pillow and a gray blanket or clothing item draped over its left arm. Above the sofa is a decorative wooden wall featuring a central rectangular mirror or painting surrounded by smaller glass panels. The walls and ceiling are paneled in dark wood with gold ornamental designs and accents, and the arched ceiling is predominantly green with gold patterns, complemented by silver decorative panels. A large, ornate brass chandelier hangs from the ceiling. There are two wicker armchairs with red cushions in the foreground, and a woven table between them holds a tea set, some cups, a plate with food, a napkin, and a blue ribbon. On the floor in front of the sofa are several travel items, including a closed gray trunk with brown straps, a round hat box, and a smaller ball or sphere. Next to the sofa’s right arm, a cane and a closed umbrella lean against it, and a dark top hat sits on a small table to the left. Curtains in deep red hang at the windows and are partially pulled back, revealing green-tinted glass windows and wooden paneling lining the sides of the carriage.
title: Parlor in Pullman Coach
